ci.title: CI results
ci.body: Each product's CI posts its counts here, signed: tests, RLS and anonymity suites, dependency findings, migrations waiting.
ci.step2: Store it in the repository as the secret SENTRAL_CI_SECRET, and the address above as the variable SENTRAL_EVENTS_URL.
ci.step4: Add scripts/sentral-report.mjs and its workflow step from Repo rules.

ci.requestNote: A post older than five minutes is refused; a delivery id is kept once, so a repeat changes nothing.
ci.fields: Only these fields are kept: ids, shas, counts and file names. Never send test output or logs.

fix.k: «n >= 5» becomes k-anonymity as Orgpuls enforces it: floor 3, default 5, frozen per round, in the database.
fix.npm: pnpm becomes npm: both repositories use npm.
fix.repos: «One monorepo (apps/web, apps/sentral)» becomes two repositories: Orgpuls, and Sentral on its own; Sentral reaches Orgpuls only by signed commands and events.
fix.forward: «Migrations are reversible» becomes forward-only: an applied migration is superseded, never edited; objects are set aside instead of dropped.
fix.suites: «pgTAP / supabase test db» becomes the SQL suites in supabase/tests (npm run test:db).
fix.stopHook: The Stop hook that posted a session summary to Sentral is removed: a public address, a static token on every laptop, no replay protection, and free text Sentral may not receive (rules 2, 4, 5 and 6).
fix.dispatch: «Ask Claude» by repository_dispatch with a free-text prompt is removed: Sentral does not reach GitHub, and a free prompt could carry a person's words.
fix.auditPost: roadmap-sync's step that posted findings to Sentral with SENTRAL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is removed.
fix.mcpProd: The Supabase MCP on production is removed: even read-only, SQL on production can read survey answers (Orgpuls invariants 1 and 2).
fix.sentry: Sentry is removed: no product uses it.
fix.secrets: GitHub secrets: SENTRAL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN, VERCEL_TOKEN and a «read-only» SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN are gone; SENTRAL_CI_SECRET and SENTRAL_EVENTS_URL are added.
fix.readsRepo: «Sentral reads the files through the GitHub API» becomes: Sentral does not read the repository; deploys come from Vercel's webhooks, builds from the CI's report.
fix.ciReport: New: the CI's signed report to Sentral (sentral-report.yml and scripts/sentral-report.mjs).
fix.changelog: «CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased» becomes the changelog in Sentral › Releases; the PR body carries the draft.
fix.ids: Links and triage carry ids only (tickets, deals, PRs), never a customer's name, words or amounts: git history cannot be erased.
fix.rls: «Check RLS policies exist» becomes: RLS on in the same migration; the answer tables get no policy and no grant.
fix.guard: The anonymity guard is a review aid; the SQL suites are the control.
fix.protect: protect.sh matched «*_applied*», which no file is named; it now refuses editing any existing migration.
fix.targets: Bug targets as Sentral counts them: S1 same business day 16:00, S2 3 business days, S3 14 days.
fix.rollout: Rollout: flags are on or off today; a percentage needs a flag service that does not exist yet.
fix.roadmapGen: ROADMAP.md is generated by Sentral (Markdown roadmap), not by roadmap-sync.
